name: Grow a Girlfriend
source:
Whoops! You've grown a cute mushroom girl!

She's excited to learn all about the world, and you'll need to overcome your intense social anxiety to help her live her very brief life to the fullest, or blame yourself trying.

Make the right choices to look after her mental health and have a happy, wholesome experience! Or... not :)

Your choice.

[From [url=https://trubluis.itch.io/grow-a-girlfriend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哎呀！你已经成长为一个可爱的蘑菇女孩了！

她很高兴了解世界的一切，而你需要克服强烈的社交焦虑，帮助她充分地度过她短暂的一生，否则就责怪自己的努力。

做出正确的选择，照顾她的心理健康，并拥有快乐、健康的经历！或者…不是:)

你的选择。

[来自[url=https://trubluis.itch.io/grow-a-girlfriend]itch.io[/url]]
